Upstream requirements: SRS_Can_01145
⌈If the function CanSM_TxTimeoutException is referenced with a Channel, which
is not configured as CanSMNetworkHandle in the CanSM configuration, it shall report
CANSM_E_INVALID_NETWORK_HANDLE to the DET.⌋
Remarks: Reentrancy is necessary for different Channels.
